newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit remains weak on firmer dollar/majors.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit remains weak on firmer dollar/majors.

text.p: The ringgit remained weak through Asian trading, pressured by the strength in the dollar/majors, dealers said.
Some selling of the ringgit against the Singapore dollar also weighed on the Malaysian unit, they said.
"London or New York may try to push dollar/ringgit towards 2.5200 but there will be very strong resistance," said a dealer with a large Malaysian bank.
Dealers said demand for the ringgit out of Kuala Lumpur and fears of central bank intervention would limit its downside to about 2.5190/5200 for the time being.
At 0900 GMT, the ringgit was quoted at 2.5170/80 a dollar against 2.5148/58 at the close of Kuala Lumpur on Monday.
Dealers said they expected heavy offers of dollar/ringgit from local players at 2.5200.
They said Bank Negara was also likely to intervene at around that level to cushion the ringgit from any heavy speculation.
The central bank was said to be checking rates at 2.5190/5200 last Wednesday.
Dealers added that the dollar/ringgit would continue to be supported at 2.5120/30.
